I2VA:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A single continuous take: an almost imperceptible slow push-in on a matte charcoal-black studio backdrop with a faint cool sheen, a soft diagonal light falloff from the upper left, and a fine paper-like grain across the surface. Suspended in an exploded arrangement above it are five precision-machined plates in muted olive-gold brushed metal: four thick quarter-circle arc segments with sweeping concave inner edges, crisp radiused corners, a pale gold highlight travelling across each face and a soft contact shadow beneath, plus a central four-pointed concave star plate of the same material. The palette is olive, brass and gunmetal against near-black. The plates hang perfectly still for a beat. Then the top-left arc segment glides along a straight, measured path toward the ring, turning a few degrees as it travels, and seats against its neighbour with a quiet, precise click. The bottom-right segment follows on the same controlled vector, and the remaining two quarters slide in and lock in turn, the seams closing to a hairline, until the four arcs form a flawless complete ring. The central star plate descends into the empty middle of the ring and settles dead centre with one final delicate click, the emblem now perfectly aligned and completely still, the way an armoured faceplate seals itself. A moment of stillness holds. Then the star ignites from within with a saturated money-green emerald light, blooming outward across the brushed metal and casting a faint green rim onto the inner faces of the ring. The glow steadies into a clean, luminous money-green core, and the glowing star begins to tremble with an almost imperceptible sub-degree oscillation, a fine surgical tremor, while the rest of the emblem stays locked. The camera continues its slow push-in and the shot ends holding on the faintly trembling green star, emerald light softly washing the interior of the ring.

overall_soundscape: A deep, soft room tone runs beneath like a quiet clinical space. Each plate that seats gives a small, clean, low mechanical click, with a faint soft metallic scrape accompanying its glide. When the central star locks into the ring, one delicate, bright bell-like ping resolves the assembly. As the green light ignites, a warm rising harmonic shimmer blooms quietly and then settles into a steady, low sustained hum.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, minimal ambient score built on a low sustained pad, with a soft high bell tone entering only when the green light ignites. Calm and unhurried, gentle dynamics, no percussion.
